info.title: Bulk IP Threat Intelligence API Reference
info.description: Retrieve threat intelligence and security profiles for up to 50,000 IP addresses in a single request. Each entry in the response array includes a composite 0-100 threat score plus per-signal flags for VPN, proxy, residential proxy, Tor exit node, bot, spam, known-attacker, and corporate-gateway activity, along with confidence scores and provider names where available. Use the `fields` and `excludes` query parameters to control which security signals are returned, reducing payload size for bulk workflows. A bad or bogon IP in the batch returns a per-item error object instead of failing the entire request, so you can process mixed-validity inputs in one call.

post.summary: Retrieve threat intelligence data for multiple IP addresses in a single request
post.description: Get security profiles including threat score, VPN, proxy, Tor, bot, and spam detection for up to 50,000 IPs per request. Each item in the response array corresponds to one requested IP; invalid or bogon IPs return a per-item error object.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Supports dot notation (e.g. security.threat_score).

parameters.name: excludes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to remove from the response. Supports dot notation (e.g. security.is_tor).

200.description: Successful threat intelligence response. The response array always contains one item for each input IP, preserving order; an IP that fails validation (invalid, bogon, reserved, or not found) yields an error item instead of a security result.

partialFailure.summary: Response with an invalid IP mixed in - that item returns an error object instead of security data

value.message: Provided IP address 'not-an-ip' is not valid

bogonIp.summary: Bogon or reserved IP - returns an error object for that item

400.description: Bad Request - Missing, empty, or malformed request body

invalidRequestBody.summary: Missing, empty, or malformed `ips` in the request body

value.message: Please provide data in required format in request body

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

BulkIpSecurityRequest.description: Request body for bulk IP threat intelligence lookup.

ips.description: List of 1–50,000 IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses to look up for threat intelligence data.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

BulkIpSecurityItemError.description: Per-item error, returned in place of a security result when an individual IP is invalid, bogon/reserved, or not found in the database.

message.description: Human-readable reason this IP could not be resolved.

BulkIpSecurityResultItem.description: Threat intelligence result for one successfully resolved IP address.

ip.description: The IP address used for the lookup (IPv4 or IPv6).

BulkIpSecurityResponse.description: Array of per-IP results, one entry per requested IP, in the same order as the request. Each entry is either a security result or, if that IP could not be resolved, an error object.

Security.description: Threat intelligence and security information for the IP.

threat_score.description: Overall threat score for the IP address. Ranges from 0 to 100. 100 indicates the highest risk.

is_tor.description: Indicates whether the IP is a Tor exit node.

is_proxy.description: Indicates whether the IP is associated with a proxy network.

proxy_provider_names.description: List of detected proxy provider names, when available.

proxy_confidence_score.description: Confidence score (0-100) for proxy detection, when flag is true. Defaults to 0.

proxy_last_seen.description: Last seen date (YYYY-MM-DD) for proxy activity, when available.

is_residential_proxy.description: Indicates whether the IP is associated with a residential proxy network.

is_vpn.description: Indicates whether the IP is associated with a VPN network.

vpn_provider_names.description: List of detected VPN provider names, when available.

vpn_confidence_score.description: Confidence score (0-100) for VPN detection, when flag is true. Defaults to 0.

vpn_last_seen.description: Last seen date (YYYY-MM-DD) for VPN activity, when available.

is_relay.description: Indicates whether the IP is associated with a relay network.

is_anonymous.description: Indicates whether the IP is anonymous. True if VPN, proxy, Tor, or relay is detected.

is_known_attacker.description: Indicates whether the IP is flagged for known attacker behavior.

is_bot.description: Indicates whether the IP is associated with bot activity.

bot_confidence_score.description: Confidence score (0-100) that the IP is used for bot activity. Set only when is_bot is true; otherwise 0.

bot_operator_name.description: Organization that runs the bot, when known. Usually present only for declared bots such as search engine crawlers.

bot_type.description: Kind of automated activity detected, when known. Declared bots (is_known_good_bot true): search_engine, ai_crawler, ai_assistant, seo_crawler, site_monitor, link_preview, feed_fetcher, archiver, ad_verification, scanner. Undeclared bots (is_known_good_bot false): scanner, scraper, exploit, credential_stuffing, brute_force, worm. New values can be added over time, so treat it as a plain string.

is_known_good_bot.description: Indicates whether the bot is a declared bot with a verifiable operator, such as a search engine crawler, uptime monitor, or security scanner.

bot_last_seen.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the bot activity was last observed, when available.

is_spam.description: Indicates whether the IP is associated with spam activity.

is_cloud_provider.description: Indicates whether the IP belongs to a cloud provider.

cloud_provider_name.description: Name of the cloud provider, if the IP address belongs to a cloud provider.

is_corporate_gateway.description: Indicates whether the IP is an outbound address of a corporate security gateway (SWG, SSE, or SASE), meaning traffic from a company network is routed through it.

corporate_gateway_type.description: Kind of corporate gateway, when known. Known values: secure_web_gateway, browser_isolation.

corporate_gateway_provider_name.description: Name of the company that operates the gateway, such as Zscaler, when known.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
